summary: META stock dropped ~10% post-Q1 earnings despite beat (rev $56.3B vs $55.5B est, EPS $7.31 vs $6.79 est) due to capex raise to $125-145B and decelerating growth guidance. New Mexico seeking $3.7B + platform overhaul in youth harm trial. Reuters won Pulitzer for investigations into Meta's harmful AI chatbots. Workforce reduction: ~10% (~8,000 employees). Data center financing deal with Morgan Stanley/JPMorgan ($13B for El Paso facility).
